cover_headline: Indians Posted to UK Now Avoid Double Social Security for Five Years
facts: The Double Contributions Convention, in force since July 15, 2026, extends the NIC exemption for detached workers from 52 weeks to 60 months
Indian employees sent by an India-based employer to the UK for up to 60 months pay no UK National Insurance and keep contributing to India's EPF instead
Detached workers need a Certificate of Coverage from EPFO as proof; visa costs still apply, including a £769 application fee and £1,035 a year Immigration Health Surcharge

end.headline: Indians Posted to UK Now Avoid Double Social Security for Five Years
end.line: The Double Contributions Convention extends the NIC exemption for detached workers from 52 weeks to 60 months — if they hold an EPFO Certificate of Coverage.
